finalText:
Redis died at 02:14:07, `ECONNREFUSED 10.0.0.12:6379`.

Cache fell back to direct store reads. Store got overloaded, timeouts started.

Queue depth climbed steadily, 52 up to 568. Redis reconnects kept failing, 12 attempts over 17 minutes.

At 02:31:44 worker-2 hit heap out of memory. Supervisor restarted it, then at 02:31:52 the api became unresponsive and got killed.

Root cause: Redis outage with no working fallback, backlog grew until OOM. Fix Redis at 10.0.0.12 and add backpressure so queue depth can't grow unbounded.
